description: A FastAPI application defining endpoints for file uploads and serving an HTML form page.

methods.name: create_files( files: Annotated[list[bytes], File(description="Multiple files as bytes")], )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/files/' endpoint; accepts multiple files as bytes and returns their sizes.

methods.name: create_upload_files( files: Annotated[ list[UploadFile], File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile") ], )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/uploadfiles/' endpoint; accepts multiple UploadFile objects and returns their filenames.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns an HTML page with two forms for file uploads.

ctags.name: create_files
ctags.signature: ( files: Annotated[list[bytes], File(description="Multiple files as bytes")], )

ctags.name: create_upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: Annotated[ list[UploadFile], File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile") ], )
